vibe_rationale: Community-run, curated surf film program at the national surf museum with a strong surf core; a narrow single format and small in scale.
fit_notes: Adult surf and summer crowd on the Surf Coast with an active-lifestyle angle and a named festival director to approach. Past partners (Reef, Bells Beach Brewing, Patagonia) show brands are welcome, but the audience is only about 250 people and 2024 to 2026 partners are unconfirmed.
